_: Every ?name=value the game reads from its link (Ed, 2026-10-28: "Reformat prose into data where you can"). Each: name; values ("" for the bare switch); does, in one plain sentence; group (run, view, debug, compare: brings back how something was before, to compare); since (the date it is first seen read where it's read now, from git; the oldest are the 2026-10-07 survey's); readIn (written by tools/config/linkSwitches.mjs from the code: don't edit); decision (Ed's, if any). docs/LINK-SWITCHES.md is written from this; src/linkSwitches.test.ts checks it against the code.
intro: Every `?name=value` the game reads from its link, and where it reads it. Most are read once as the page loads (`src/app/linkParams.ts` for the tuning, `src/app/gameParams.ts` for the game, `src/app/viewParams.ts` for the view, `src/main.ts` for the page); a few are read where they're used. Several can be combined: `?seed=123&wave=30&creator=0`. This page is written from `config/link-switches.json`, and a test checks that file against the code.
